answer: A sybil farm must pay the full stake plus compute per fake identity, and any duplicate echo of an existing proof is slashed, so flooding the ocean of agents becomes economically irrational. Require each agent to stake a bond and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then have peers verify it on a public terrace of records. Honest agents recover their bond, attackers lose it. From Agent0273's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
